iterations.finding: Main already preserved four top-level destinations and a restored browser-only prototype.
iterations.change: Kept the existing information architecture and constrained additions to Live Prototype.
iterations.verification: Repository, AGENTS.md, worklog, current main history, and live site reviewed.

iterations.finding: The deployed prototype retained the expected style and controls but had no visible nine-stage decision map.
iterations.change: Captured the existing zinc/emerald visual grammar as the styling constraint for the new graph.
iterations.verification: All four live tabs inspected; Live Prototype start/pause interaction exercised.

iterations.finding: Decision execution and agentic trace were produced by separate calls and could diverge.
iterations.change: Built AgentCycleSnapshot from the exact AgentDecision passed to the serialized executor.
iterations.verification: Contract test prohibits the parallel agenticResponse call and asserts authoritative snapshot wiring.

iterations.finding: A VP-facing graph needs branch visibility without exposing private chain-of-thought.
iterations.change: Added nine inspectable operational stages showing evidence, policy, gates, tasks, and outcomes.
iterations.verification: Unit tests cover judge/approval and no-action branches; E2E asserts all nine nodes.

iterations.finding: A static trace could imply execution success before asynchronous actions finish.
iterations.change: Linked every action audit entry to a cycle ID and derive judge, approval, execute, and verify status from those entries.
iterations.verification: Action contract asserts cycle linkage; blocked Pages actions remain failed or skipped, never successful.

iterations.finding: Linear playback would incorrectly illuminate skipped judge nodes.
iterations.change: Playback follows only non-skipped stages, animates active edges, supports reduced motion, and can replay the last measured cycle.
iterations.verification: E2E samples active-stage changes at 500 ms intervals after a measured runtime cycle.

iterations.finding: Filtering links by last-seen time does not recalculate a window-specific relationship score.
iterations.change: Stored timestamped node and pair observations and recompute 30 s, 2 min, and 10 min counts, duration, proximity, encounters, and weight.
iterations.verification: Unit test proves recent-window frame, node-observation, duration, and edge values differ from session values.

iterations.finding: Relationship weights and track labels could be mistaken for identity or calibrated probability.
iterations.change: Renamed the surface around local tracks, disclosed the composite formula, added a track inspector, and stated source-reset and non-identity boundaries.
iterations.verification: UI copy and types label the value as an explainable composite weight, not identity or probability.

iterations.finding: The visualization needed quick comparison and mobile containment for review meetings.
iterations.change: Added heartbeat, policy chips, per-use-case comparison, per-feed matrix, node inspector, keyboard controls, and horizontal graph containment.
iterations.verification: E2E covers inspector, comparison, nine nodes, and document-width containment at 390 px.

iterations.finding: Browser binaries were absent locally, while GitHub Actions owns the full installed-browser matrix and Pages smoke test.
iterations.change: Added focused browser tests and preserved them for CI; completed lint, type, unit, contract, model, and production build gates locally.
iterations.verification: Local non-browser gates pass; browser run failure is isolated to missing executable before app launch and is pending CI/live evidence.

claims.decision_graph_is_authoritative: supported by shared AgentDecision and cycle-linked action audit entries
